title: Kenworth T610 SAR FUPS Road Train Custom Bullbar #60
description: Kenworth T610 SAR high tensile polished aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar. Texas style channel with lower flange plate. Standard 76mm diameter pipe but optional 88mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. Heavy duty tow pin and high tensile aluminium backing plate. Reversible Road Train signs on aluminium plates with KW engraved logo. One piece pipes through drilled heavy duty posts. Driving light mounts fitted to customer spec. Bull bar can be custom built to your specification.
